propositions: rebar cannot reconcile against self-hosted Jira Data Center due to REST v2 vs v3, wiki-markup vs ADF, PAT vs ACLI auth, and name-based vs accountId user identity differences
PR #120's separate DC adapter duplicates field maps and sanitizers across packages and reaches into private Cloud adapter internals, creating undocumented coupling with no contract enforcement

Code sharing must be restructured as an explicit jira_family sub-seam with location-pinned modules (adf.py, outbound_fields.py, comment_limits.py) shared via dependency inversion rather than relocation

Field mapping, label sanitization, link relations, and probe classification must exist as single implementations in jira_family/, consumed by both Cloud and DC backends to eliminate duplication and drift
Rich-text encoding (ADF for Cloud, wiki/plain text for DC) and user-identity model (accountId for Cloud, name for DC) must be formalized as contracts with one implementation per deployment

DC backend must enforce HTTPS for base_url, reject non-TLS unless allow_insecure=true is set with a warning, never disable certificate verification, and require JIRA_PAT from environment only (never config file)
